verses.html: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.
verses.text: It is reported commonly that there is fornication among you, and such fornication as is not so much as named among the Gentiles, that one should have his father's wife.

verses.html: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.
verses.text: And ye are puffed up, and have not rather mourned, that he that hath done this deed might be taken away from among you.

verses.html: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,
verses.text: For I verily, as absent in body, but present in spirit, have judged already, as though I were present, concerning him that hath so done this deed,

verses.html: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.text: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when ye are gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.html: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.
verses.text: To deliver such an one unto Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

verses.html: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?
verses.text: Your glorying is not good. Know ye not that a little leaven leaveneth the whole lump?

verses.html: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:
verses.text: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened. For even Christ our passover is sacrificed for us:

verses.html: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.
verses.text: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old leaven, neither with the leaven of malice and wickedness; but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

verses.html: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:
verses.text: I wrote unto you in an epistle not to company with fornicators:

verses.html: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.
verses.text: Yet not altogether with the fornicators of this world, or with the covetous, or extortioners, or with idolaters; for then must ye needs go out of the world.

verses.html: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.
verses.text: But now I have written unto you not to keep company, if any man that is called a brother be a fornicator, or covetous, or an idolater, or a railer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner; with such an one no not to eat.

verses.html: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?
verses.text: For what have I to do to judge them also that are without? do not ye judge them that are within?

verses.html: But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
verses.text: But them that are without God judgeth. Therefore put away from among yourselves that wicked person.
